newsitem.title: CHILE: Bema strike not affecting Refugio output.
newsitem.headline: Bema strike not affecting Refugio output.

text.p: A strike by hourly workers at Bema Gold's Refugio gold mine in Chile has not affected production and should be resolved soon, said Bema president Clive Johnson.
"It is not hurting production levels as the majority of people at the mine are contractors," not hourly workers, he told Reuters. "We think the dispute can be resolved within 15 days."

Strikers were all members of a recently formed union of hourly workers and represented 26 percent of the Refugio workforce, he said. Workers went on strike Monday after talks with the union, which started in mid-December, broke down.
Johnson said Refugio was relying on non-union workers and brought in temporary workers to keep the mining working without disruption.
